arStrings.szText: Casting a {c_important}Pyromancy{/c}, {c_important}Shock{/c}, or {c_important}Frost{/c} Skill increases your {c_important}Burning{/c}, {c_important}Shocking{/c}, or {c_important}Frostbite{/c} damage by {c_number}[SF_0 * 100|x%|]{/c} for {c_number}[SF_5]{/c} seconds. Each element only stacks once, maxing at {c_number}[(SF_0 * 100) * SF_1|x%|]{/c}, with each element active.
